name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: If Slav does not go with Walnut, then Mikhail goes with French.
Mikhail goes with none of Sicilian, Slav, or Walnut.
Between Boris and Rosewood, one goes with French and the other with Sicilian.
Either Judit goes with Rosewood, or French goes with Marble — but not both.
French goes with at least one of Judit, Marble, or Walnut.
Either Boris goes with French or Boris goes with Benoni.
